editor.gated: "{{ feature }}" needs the {{ plan }} plan. Visitors do not see it.
editor.contact_form: "Fill the contact form" needs a contact form on this page (add the Contact form section). Shopify emails you what the buyer sends.
editor.gated_downloads: Gated downloads are hidden from guests, not protected: anyone with a file's link can still download it.
editor.gated_downloads_tag: Gated downloads are hidden from guests and customers without the tag "{{ tag }}", not protected: anyone with a file's link can still download it.
editor.ar: Add "{{ ns }}.ar_usdz" / "{{ ns }}.ar_glb" metafields or a 3D model to the product for AR on every phone. A model made from the IFC works on iPhone and iPad only.
editor.classification: Add a product metafield "{{ ns }}.classification" (one "System|Code|Title" per line or list item) for codes that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.compat: Add a "{{ ns }}.compatible_with" product metafield to list the apps and versions you tested.
editor.compliance: Add an https link to an .ids file in this block or in the product metafield "{{ ns }}.ids_url" to show the IDS badge.
editor.dpp: Add product metafields in "{{ ns }}" (epd_url, gwp_a1a3, declared_unit, dop_url, ce_marking, instructions_languages, substances_of_concern, gtin, manufacturer_contact…) to fill this panel before the 3D model loads.
editor.rooms: Add product metafields "{{ ns }}.area", "{{ ns }}.bedrooms", "{{ ns }}.bathrooms" and "{{ ns }}.storeys" for key specs that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.specs: Add product metafields in the "{{ ns }}" namespace for specs that show before the 3D model loads.
editor.takeoff: Add a product metafield "{{ ns }}.boq" (one row per line, cells split by |) for a table that shows before the 3D model loads, and "{{ ns }}.unit_prices" (JSON) for an indicative total.
editor.viewer_link: IFC Viewer Online: paste an https link to an .ifc file (Content > Files) or to a scene.
editor.product_link: IFC Viewer Online: add an https link to an .ifc file in the product metafield {{ ns }}.{{ key }} (URL or file).
